skills.generic.SummonBlingGnome.label: Bling Gnome
skills.generic.SummonBlingGnome.description:
Place this skilzizzil in your skill tray to 'auto-magically' summon up a mad Bling Gnome, yo!
					This phat lil' gnome, Pope Sweet Geebus, cannot resist the stank of sweet, sweet, gold! He will pick up
					all gold dropped for you! Activate the skill to tell this crazy lil' gnome to automatically
					convert all items assigned to you to gold that are Rare quality and lower! Bling Bling! Word.

skills.generic.1HMeleeSpeedBuff.label: 1H Swivel Arm Action
skills.generic.1HMeleeSpeedBuff.description: Improves Attack Speed with one handed melee weapons by [AttributeEffect.Value]% for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.2HMeleeSpeedBuff.label: 2H Swivel Arm Action
skills.generic.2HMeleeSpeedBuff.description: Improves Attack Speed with two handed melee weapons by [AttributeEffect.Value]% for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.AggroIncreaseModBuff.label: Offensive Gesture
skills.generic.AggroIncreaseModBuff.description:
You know a very offensive gesture that shocks and awes even the most thick-skinned monsters.
		Performing this offensive gesture increases your Monster Aggro by [AttributeEffect.Value]% for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.
		This means monsters are more likely to attack you rather than some other, less offensive, Dungeon Runner.

skills.generic.BlockKnockdownProcPassive.label: I'm Rubber, You're Screwed
skills.generic.BlockKnockdownProcPassive.description:
Place this in your skill tray to passively upgrade your shield. Every time you
				block a Melee Attack, there is a chance the attacker will be knocked down. Boing-oing-oing!

skills.generic.Butcher.label: Butcher
skills.generic.Butcher.description:
A savage melee attack that adds [SpellWeaponDamageEffect.ARMod]% to your 
					Attack Rating and deals [SpellWeaponDamageEffect.DamageMod+Constant.DamageMod]% of 
					your normal Melee Weapon Damage to your target with a chance to knock them down.

skills.generic.Charge.label: Holy Roller
skills.generic.Charge.description:
A magical attack where you charge the enemy at an un-Goshly rate of speed
			and unleash a powerful blast doing [DamageEffect.MinDamage] to
			[DamageEffect.MaxDamage] Divine Damage. The overzealous thumpage
			slows the target by [-AttributeEffect.Value]% for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds
			and also has a chance to knock them down.

skills.generic.Cleave.label: Cleave
skills.generic.Cleave.description:
A melee attack with an additional [SpellWeaponDamageEffect.ARMod]% added to your Attack Rating that can hit up to [SpellWeaponDamageEffect.NumTargets] 
			adjacent enemies dealing [SpellWeaponDamageEffect.DamageMod+Constant.DamageMod]% of your normal Melee Weapon Damage to each target.

skills.generic.CleaveUpgradeProcPassive.label: Awesome Cleavage
skills.generic.CleaveUpgradeProcPassive.description:
Place this in your skill tray to augment your Cleave skill. Every time a monster is hit
			by your Cleave, there is a chance for Gosh's Awesomeness to intervene and augment the cleavage.
			This intervention causes between [skills.generic.CleaveUpgradeProc.ProjectileEffect.Damage.MinDamage]
			to [skills.generic.CleaveUpgradeProc.ProjectileEffect.Damage.MaxDamage] Divine Damage on the target and
			a nearby enemy. Furthermore, there is a chance they will be knocked down. Each augmentation costs
			[Description.ManaCost] Mana.

skills.generic.DivineDamageBuff.label: Divine Ascendancy
skills.generic.DivineDamageBuff.description: Increases all of your Divine Damage by [AttributeEffect.Value] damage per second for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.DivineMeleeAttack.label: Soul Rend
skills.generic.DivineMeleeAttack.description: Your weapon becomes infused with divine energy that rends your target's soul for [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage*SpellModEffect.Duration] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage*SpellModEffect.Duration] Divine Damage over [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.DivineResistBuff.label: Divine Resistance
skills.generic.DivineResistBuff.description:
Increases Divine Resistance by [AttributeEffect.Value] 
			for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.DivineResistPassive.label: Divine Ward
skills.generic.DivineResistPassive.description:
Passively increases Divine Resistance by [AttributeEffect.Value] and reduces all other 
			Resistances by [-AttributeEffect2.Value] while placed in your skill tray.

skills.generic.FearMeleeAttack.label: Fear of Gosh
skills.generic.FearMeleeAttack.description:
Your melee weapon becomes blessed by Gosh Almighty causing between [DamageEffect.MinDamage*DamageModEffect.Duration] to 
			[DamageEffect.MaxDamage*DamageModEffect.Duration] Divine Damage over [DamageModEffect.Duration] seconds to your target and possibly several other nearby enemies.
			Each enemy that takes damage will also potentially be stricken with the Fear of Gosh causing them to slowly flee while they take damage.

skills.generic.FearResistModPassive.label: Banner of Foolish Bravery
skills.generic.FearResistModPassive.description:
You carry a banner in your pocket that inspires you to ignore the most primitive part of your brain.
			You know, the part that tells you to be fearful in certain '100% you're gonna die' situations. Your only options are
			fight or fight MORE! There is no fight or flight.

			Thus, when you carry this pocket-sized banner in your skill tray it will passively increase your Fear Resistance
			by [AttributeEffect.Value]%.

skills.generic.FireMeleeSummon.label: My Flaming Buddy
skills.generic.FireMeleeSummon.description:
My Flaming Buddy, My Flaming Buddy
Where ever you go, he goes-ish.

To get your very own My Flaming Buddy, attack an enemy with this skill! Doing so will dish out between [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage] Fire Damage on your enemy and will potentially create a new Level [SpawnEffect.PowerLevel] My Flaming Buddy costing you an additional [ProcMod.ManaCost] Mana. Don't get too attached to your new Buddy because his friendship is very temporary; 8 seconds to be exact. Look at the bright side, you don't have to deal with any long term commitments.

My Flaming Buddy, My Flaming Buddy and me!

skills.generic.HealSelf.label: Heal Self, not Other
skills.generic.HealSelf.description:
When potions aren't handy, this skill is. It will regenerate [AttributeEffect.Value*SpellModEffect.Duration]% 
					of your health over [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds. Beware: This skill is easily interrupted if you take damage!

skills.generic.MeleeAttackRatingModPassi.label: Mad Melee Mastery
skills.generic.MeleeAttackRatingModPassi.description:
This skill shows off your uncanny ability to hit your opponents with melee weapons. 
			You are so good at scoring hits that you are willing to handicap yourself just to make it 'Interesting.'  
			This skill passively increases your Melee Attack Rating by [AttributeEffect.Value]% (Word!).
			It also reduces your Health by [-AttributeEffect2.Value]% (Very interesting, indeed!) while 
			placed in your skill tray.

skills.generic.MeleeDamageReflectionBuff.label: Retribution
skills.generic.MeleeDamageReflectionBuff.description: When you get hit by melee damage, the enemy that hit you gets hit back for [AttributeEffect.Value]% of the damage they dealt to you. This aura lasts for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.MinMoveSpeedBuff.label: Light in the Loafers
skills.generic.MinMoveSpeedBuff.description:
This skill enables you to be quicker on your feet by making your loafers much, much lighter (and stylish, but that is beside the point)!
			This means you can ignore any negative speed modifiers (including Monster Molasses) to move
			at maximum normal speed for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.ShadowRage.label: Dark Conniption
skills.generic.ShadowRage.description:
Every time you strike an enemy with your melee weapon it has a chance to zap your target with [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage] Shadow
					Damage. Each successful zap costs [ShadowDamageProc.ManaCost] Mana. Every time your target gets zapped, your weapon arm goes into a conniption fit that increases your Melee Attack Speed 
					by [AttributeEffect.Value]% for [ModEffect7.Duration] seconds.  Up to 9 conniption fits may stack and the overall Dark Conniption lasts for [ModEffect.Duration]
					seconds! Of course, the conniption fits do have their downside.  As your Attack Speed increases from these effects, your Defense Rating and Stun Resistance are reduced.

skills.generic.SlowDebuff.label: Unnerving Shout
skills.generic.SlowDebuff.description: You invoke the Word of Gosh and let out a bone rattling shout that unnerves up to [SpellAOEEffect.NumTargets] enemies within [SpellAOEEffect.Radius] meters, slowing their Attack Speed by [-AttackSpeedMod.Value]% and Movement Speed by [-MovementSpeedMod.Value]% for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.Stomp.label: Righteous Stomp
skills.generic.Stomp.description: A wave of holiness that may knock down up to [SpellAOEEffect.NumTargets] enemies within [SpellAOEEffect.Radius] meters and deal [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage] Divine Damage to each one.

skills.generic.StrengthBuff.label: Stupid Strength
skills.generic.StrengthBuff.description: This skill increases your Strength by [AttributeEffect.Value]% and silences you, preventing all use of skills for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.StunResistBuff.label: Thickheadedness
skills.generic.StunResistBuff.description: Increases your Stun Resistance by [StunMod.Value]% for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.FireBolt.label: Fire Bolt
skills.generic.FireBolt.description: Shoots a bolt of fire at your enemies, causing [DamageEffect.MinDamage] to [DamageEffect.MaxDamage] Fire Damage.

skills.generic.FireCone.label: Crispy Critters
skills.generic.FireCone.description:
You prefer your enemies well done. This skill shoots a short jet of flames that roasts any enemies
				caught within the blast! Depending on how long they roast on the open flames for, an enemy could take
				anywhere between [DamageEffect.MinDamage] to [DamageEffect.MaxDamage*3] Fire Damage.

skills.generic.FireDamageBuff.label: Pyromania
skills.generic.FireDamageBuff.description: Increases all of your Fire Damage by [AttributeEffect.Value] damage per second for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.FireResistBuff.label: Fire Resistance
skills.generic.FireResistBuff.description:
Increases Fire Resistance by [AttributeEffect.Value] 
					for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.FireResistPassive.description:
Passively increases Fire Resistance by [AttributeEffect.Value] and reduces all other 
			Resistances by [-AttributeEffect2.Value] while placed in your skill tray.

skills.generic.FireRing.label: Ring of Fire
skills.generic.FireRing.description:
It burns, burns, burns... up to 12 enemies by sending out a wave of fire bolts in a 360 degree radius. 
			Each bolt deals between [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage] Fire 
			Damage and has a chance to inflict between [FireDamageEffect.MinDamage*ModEffect.Duration] 
			to [FireDamageEffect.MaxDamage*ModEffect.Duration] Fire Damage over [ModEffect.Duration] 
			seconds.

skills.generic.IceBolt.label: Ice Bolt
skills.generic.IceBolt.description: Shoots a bolt of ice which deals [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage] Ice Damage to the target and has a chance to slow its Movement Speed by [-SpeedMod.Value]% and Attack Speed by [-AttackSpeedMod.Value]% for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.IceDamageBuff.label: Chilling Touch
skills.generic.IceDamageBuff.description: Increases all of your Ice Damage by [AttributeEffect.Value] damage per second for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.IceMultiBolt.label: Ice Shards
skills.generic.IceMultiBolt.description: Shoots 3 shards of ice in your forward facing arc. Each shard causes [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage] Ice Damage.

skills.generic.IceResistBuff.label: Ice Resistance
skills.generic.IceResistBuff.description:
Increases Ice Resistance by [AttributeEffect.Value] 
			for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.IceResistPassive.label: Ice Ward
skills.generic.IceResistPassive.description:
Passively increases Ice Resistance by [AttributeEffect.Value] and reduces all other 
			Resistances by [-AttributeEffect2.Value] while placed in your skill tray.

skills.generic.ManaSelf.label: Spontaneous Re-Generation
skills.generic.ManaSelf.description:
You have solved one of the greatest mysteries of the Universe, you can create Mana from Mana! Here is the genius formula everyone is clamoring for: More Mana = MC^2 * Mana + 12! This skill will regenerate [AttributeEffect.Value*SpellModEffect.Duration]% 
					of your Mana over [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds. Holla! Beware: This skill is easily interrupted if you take damage!

skills.generic.ManaShield.label: Blue Screen of Life
skills.generic.ManaShield.description: [ShieldMod.DamageAbsorbed]% of all Health Damage you receive is transferred to your Mana for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds. The Mana allocation process is not efficient however, so the damage applied to your Mana is inflated by an additional [ShieldMod.ManaDamageMod]%. Also note, Blue Screen of Life will come to a crashing halt should you run out of Mana.

skills.generic.ShadowBolt.label: Shadow Bolt
skills.generic.ShadowBolt.description: Shoots 3 bolts of shadow energy that seek your target and deal [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage] Shadow Damage per bolt.

skills.generic.ShadowDamageBuff.label: Dark Wizardry
skills.generic.ShadowDamageBuff.description: Increases all of your Shadow Damage by [AttributeEffect.Value] damage per second for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.ShadowLightning.label: Shadow Lightning
skills.generic.ShadowLightning.description: Strikes a target with a powerful bolt of lightning, which leaps to up to 5 enemies and deals [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage] Shadow Damage.

skills.generic.ShadowLightningKnockdown.label: Shadow Word: Smackdown
skills.generic.ShadowLightningKnockdown.description:
Smacks a target with [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage] 
						Shadow Damage with a chance to knock them down. This process is then repeated,
						potentially affecting a total of [SpellChainProjectile.NumChains] enemies, one right after the other.
						So, it goes something like this:
						SMACK! Oh, you want some too? Well here ya go then, SMACK!
						You feeling left out? Get ya some, SMACK! 
						Oh, and another thing... SMACK! So on, and so on.

skills.generic.ShadowLightningUpgradePro.label: Improved Shadow Lightning
skills.generic.ShadowLightningUpgradePro.description:
Place this in your skill tray to upgrade your Shadow Lightning skill. Every time a monster is hit by your Shadow Lightning it has
					 a chance to arc and damage an additional [skills.generic.ShadowLightningUpgradeProc.Projectile.NumChains]
					 monsters for [skills.generic.ShadowLightningUpgradeProc.ProjectileEffect.Damage.MinDamage]
					 to [skills.generic.ShadowLightningUpgradeProc.ProjectileEffect.Damage.MaxDamage] Shadow Damage. Each new lightning bolt
					 costs [Description.ManaCost] Mana.

skills.generic.ShadowResistBuff.label: Shadow Resistance
skills.generic.ShadowResistBuff.description:
Increases Shadow Resistance by [AttributeEffect.Value] 
					for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.ShadowResistPassive.description:
Passively increases Shadow Resistance by [AttributeEffect.Value] and reduces all other 
			Resistances by [-AttributeEffect2.Value] while placed in your skill tray.

skills.generic.SnowmanHealthModAuraBuff.label: Snow Globe
skills.generic.SnowmanHealthModAuraBuff.description:
With all the Dungeon Warming going on these days, it's best to give Chill Bill a fighting chance. If Chill Bill is not too far away, your snow globe can be activated to provide a sudden Max Health increase of [AttributeEffect.Value]% that will last for [ModEffect.Duration] seconds. 
			Along with the Health boost, whenever Chill Bill gets hit by a melee attack he will have a 25% chance to reduce the attacker's Movement Speed by [-SpeedMod.Value]% and Attack Speed by [-AttackSpeedMod.Value]% for [SpellProcModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.SnowManIceDamageProcAuraM.label: Nippy Twigs
skills.generic.SnowManIceDamageProcAuraM.description:
Activate this skill when Chill Bill is nearby to boost his feeble little twig hands with Ice Magic! Every time he strikes an enemy his attacks will dish out additional ice damage that is roughly 350% more powerful than his normal attack damage for [ModEffect.Duration] seconds! But wait, there's more!
			Each successful frigid hit also slows the target's Movement Speed and Attack Speed by [-AttackSpeedMod.Value]% for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds and has a 33% chance to knock them down!

skills.generic.SnowmanFreezeAura.label: On The Rocks
skills.generic.SnowmanFreezeAura.description: Activate this skill when Chill Bill is nearby to instantly freeze him in a solid block of ice. The air surrounding the ice cube is so cold that it causes all enemies within [SlowAura.Range] meters to move and attack more slowly while they remain within that proximity.  Their Attack Speed is slowed by [-AttackSpeedMod.Value]% and their Movement Speed is slowed by [-MovementSpeedMod.Value]%. Chill Bill will remain in this frozen state for [ImmobileModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.Teleport.label: Teleport
skills.generic.Teleport.description: Quickly warp to another location of your choosing that is within line of sight.

skills.generic.Blight.label: Acidic Blight
skills.generic.Blight.description: Reduces Defense Rating by [-AttributeEffect.Value]% on up to [SpellAOEEffect.NumTargets] enemies within [SpellAOEEffect.Radius] meters for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.FearShot.label: Fear Shot
skills.generic.FearShot.description:
A ranged attack that causes Fear in your target for [ModEffect.Duration] seconds.  
						The attack has an added benefit of [DamageEffect.ARMod]% to your Attack Rating. There is a 5% chance for the 
						Fear effect to be broken if the target takes damage.

skills.generic.IceShot.label: Shiver Shot
skills.generic.IceShot.description:
This Ice enchanted shot explodes into a veritable snow storm on impact! The initial target takes
			between [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage] Ice Damage. Up to
			[AOEEffect.NumTargets] enemies within [AOEEffect.Radius] meters will take between
			[SplashDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SplashDamageEffect.MaxDamage] Ice Damage as well.
			Additionally, all enemies that take damage will be slowed due to the chilling effects of the shot.
			Each one has their Movement Speed slowed by [-SpeedMod.Value]% and their Attack Speed slowed
			by [-AttackSpeedMod.Value]% for [ModEffect.Duration] seconds. This chilling affect can be stacked
			up to 3 times.

skills.generic.InfectiousPoisonUpgradePr.label: Barf-O-Rama
skills.generic.InfectiousPoisonUpgradePr.description:
Place this in your skill tray to passively upgrade all of your ranged Poison skills. 
				Every time an enemy takes Poison Damage from a ranged Poison skill, there is a chance they will get sick and start barfing! Once an
				enemy starts to barf, as many as [ChainEffect.NumChains] other enemies may get disgusted and start barfing too! Each barfing enemy will take between
				[DamageEffect.MinDamage*ModEffect.Duration] to [DamageEffect.MaxDamage*ModEffect.Duration] Poison Damage over
				[ModEffect.Duration] seconds. Sometimes they will be knocked back due to their heaves while they are barfing their guts out.
				Each new Barf-O-Rama costs [Description.ManaCost] Mana.

skills.generic.MonsterBaitHealthModPassi.label: Extra Crispy Monster Bait
skills.generic.MonsterBaitHealthModPassi.description:
Place this in your skill tray to upgrade your Monster Bait skill. This skill
		increases the health of your Monster Bait by [AttributeEffect.Value]% because it takes longer for the monsters to chew up the extra crispy goodness.

skills.generic.NoxiousShot.label: Noxious Shot
skills.generic.NoxiousShot.description: Infuses an arrow with poison magic that explodes into a putrid cloud causing [DamageEffect.MinDamage*ModEffect.Duration] to [DamageEffect.MaxDamage*ModEffect.Duration] Poison Damage over [ModEffect.Duration] seconds to a maximum of [AOEEffect.NumTargets] enemies within [AOEEffect.Radius] meters of the target.

skills.generic.PenetrateKnockdownShot.label: Putrid Penetration
skills.generic.PenetrateKnockdownShot.description:
A putrid shot that penetrates through 
				your enemies potentially knocking each one down as it passes through them. 
				It does [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage] Poison 
				Damage on each impact.

skills.generic.PoisonBlastRadius.label: Gaseous Blast
skills.generic.PoisonBlastRadius.description: Emits a fetid cloud that causes [DamageEffect.MinDamage*ModEffect.Duration] to [DamageEffect.MaxDamage*ModEffect.Duration] Poison Damage over [ModEffect.Duration] seconds on a maximum of [AOEEffect.NumTargets] enemies within [AOEEffect.Radius] meters of the caster.

skills.generic.PoisonDamageBuff.label: Toxic Talent
skills.generic.PoisonDamageBuff.description: Increases all of your Poison Damage by [DamageMod.Value] damage per second for [ModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.PoisonResistBuff.label: Poison Resistance
skills.generic.PoisonResistBuff.description:
Increases Poison Resistance by [AttributeEffect.Value] 
			for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.PoisonResistPassive.label: Poison Ward
skills.generic.PoisonResistPassive.description:
Passively increases Poison Resistance by [AttributeEffect.Value] and reduces all other 
			Resistances by [-AttributeEffect2.Value] while placed in your skill tray.

skills.generic.PoisonShot.label: Poison Shot
skills.generic.PoisonShot.description: A ranged attack that causes [DamageEffect.MinDamage*ModEffect.Duration] to [DamageEffect.MaxDamage*ModEffect.Duration] Poison Damage over [ModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.RangedSpeedBuff.label: Trigger Finger Frenzy
skills.generic.RangedSpeedBuff.description: Improves Attack Speed with ranged weapons by [AttributeEffect.Value]% for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.Sprint.label: Spirit of the Hare
skills.generic.Sprint.description: Increases your Movement Speed by [SpeedMod.Value]% but decreases your ability to run through crowds of monsters for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds. Beware: This skill is easily interrupted if you take damage!

skills.generic.SummonMonsterBait.label: Monster Bait
skills.generic.SummonMonsterBait.description:
Summons a level [SpawnEffect.PowerLevel] monstrous BBQ Turkey Leg 
					that may lure monsters away from you for a short period of time.

skills.generic.SummonWolf.label: Summon Wolf
skills.generic.SummonWolf.description: Summons a ferocious level [SpawnEffect.PowerLevel] wolf that fights by your side until he dies.

skills.creature.CreatureGoldStun.label: Solid Gold!
skills.creature.CreatureGoldStun.description: You have been turned into gold! The Bad News: You can't really move around, use any skills, and you can be farmed for gold. The Good News: You are finally worth something!

skills.generic.CreatureGoldStun.label: Solid Gold!
skills.generic.CreatureGoldStun.description: You have been turned into gold! The Bad News: You can't really move around, use any skills, and you can be farmed for gold. The Good News: You are finally worth something!

skills.generic.TombSickness.description: You saw something gross and now you are puking uncontrollably. Oh, and congratulations, you are officially headlining Puke-a-palooza!

skills.generic.WidowerWeb.description: Your movement is impaired and your health is being drained!

skills.generic.DivineIntervention.label: Gosh's Glorious Shower of Gold
skills.generic.DivineIntervention.description:
You call upon the Almighty Gosh to intervene and aid you in vanquishing your heathenish foe. 
					Gosh will see to it that [BogusMod.Value] glorious golden rays of light
					shall rain down from the heavens all around you. Each golden beam will release its Divine energy
					at the time that Gosh's Plan calls for it (aka. randomly). Any enemy within [SpellAOEEffect.Radius] meters of an exploding beam
					will take between [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage] Divine Damage.
					Each beam can damage up to 3 enemies! On top of that, should an enemy survive the initial barrage,
					Gosh sees to it that his follower's enemies will meet their maker (Him of course) by potentially placing a curse
					upon them that increases all Divine Damage taken by [DamageTakenMod.Value]% for [SpellModEffect.Duration]
					seconds - in accordance with His Plan (meaning there is a good chance it won't happen). Ask and ye shall receive!

skills.generic.DivineRay.label: Ray of Gosh
skills.generic.DivineRay.description:
Behold, all of your prayers are answered! Okay, perhaps not all, but at least this one is! Gosh sends down a mighty ray of Divine light to smite your enemies!
					Each ray shines down upon the position you pray for and sears an area with a radius of [DivineDamageAura.Range] meters for 3 seconds.
					All the heathen caught within the ray will be smote with somewhere between [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage]
					Divine Damage for each half second they remain in the light!

skills.generic.FighterClassPassive.label: Gym Freak
skills.generic.FighterClassPassive.description:
You have spent more time in the gym than entire sports teams combined! This gives you additional Health per point of Endurance. You've also gained additional Strength from all the work outs. In addition, catching medicine balls all day has improved your Agility a bit too! The downside? You have a hard time reading your name, much less writing it. This lowers your Mana per Intellect and your Intellect overall. You also have a hard time operating simple machines with any efficiency. This means you are a bit slower with all Ranged Weapons. In addition, your Endurance suffered because you didn't stretch and properly warm-up before each workout.
+[Attribute1.Value]% Health per point of Endurance
+[Attribute3.Value] Strength
+[Attribute4.Value] Agility
[Attribute2.Value]% Mana per point of Intellect
[Attribute7.Value]% Ranged Attack Speed

[Attribute6.Value] Intellect

skills.generic.FireCurseShot.label: Dungeon Inferno
skills.generic.FireCurseShot.description:
Burn, baby, burn! Dungeon Inferno! Your shot is lettin' loose a fiery chain reaction
					that sparks up a 4 meter radius Dungeon Inferno that burns for [BogusMod.Value] seconds!
					The initial target will take [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage]
					Fire Damage. The heat is on! Up to 10 enemies that happen to boogie into the Dungeon Inferno will take
					[AuraDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [AuraDamageEffect.MaxDamage] Fire Damage for
					each second they remain in the burning pitch. Smokin! They also have a chance to be cursed
					by taking [DamageTakenMod.Value]% more Fire Damage for [CurseModEffect.Duration]
					seconds for every second they stick it out in the scorching heat. Ahhhh yeah! 
					This curse can stack up to three times! Burn, baby, BURN! Burn that monster down.

skills.generic.FireShot.label: Fire Shot
skills.generic.FireShot.description:
You have only one itching desire, for enemies to stand next to your Fire... Shot!
					Just play with this and your target might get burned for [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage]
					to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage] Fire Damage! 
					Each successful hit has a 25% chance to explode, scorching up to
					[SpellAOEEffect.NumTargets] enemies that are diggin' it too close to your target.
					Move over Rover and let the explosion take over! Each enemy will get swept off their
					feet if the target explodes and they will take
					between [ExplodeDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [ExplodeDamageEffect.MaxDamage] Fire Damage!
					Now dig this! Let them stand next to your Fire... Shot.

skills.generic.FireTrail.label: Montezuma's Revenge
skills.generic.FireTrail.description:
You ate some seriously bad tofu! Time to get to a toilet, stat! As you run around,
				you will leave some of the most horrendous gas clouds known to Man (and Gosh) behind you! Each gas cloud
				causes somewhere between [DamageEffect.MinDamage] to [DamageEffect.MaxDamage] Poison Damage when an
				enemy runs into it. On top of that, the enemy may take an additional [DamageEffect3.MinDamage*ModEffect3.Duration]
				to [DamageEffect.MaxDamage*ModEffect.Duration] Poison Damage over [ModEffect3.Duration] seconds. 
				Sadly, the bad tofu does leave its mark on you too. You take [DamageEffect3.MinDamage*ModEffect.Duration]
				to [DamageEffect3.MaxDamage*ModEffect.Duration] Fire Damage over [ModEffect2.Duration] seconds as well. Oh, it burns! It burns!

skills.generic.Hellfire.label: Hellfire
skills.generic.Hellfire.description: Unleashes the flames of hell, damaging the target and all the enemies near it.

skills.generic.IceTargetedBurst.label: Cold Snap
skills.generic.IceTargetedBurst.description:
You create a magical ice storm at a location you target that randomly spews out 12 frozen ice crystals in a 360 degree radius.
					Each crystal of ice dishes out between [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage] Ice Damage on initial impact!
					Each bone chilling impact may additionally cause between [IceDamageEffect.MinDamage*ModEffect.Duration] 
					to [IceDamageEffect.MaxDamage*ModEffect.Duration] Ice Damage over [ModEffect.Duration] seconds. Each crystal can hit up to two enemies!

skills.generic.IceTargetedBurstUpgradePr.label: Oh, Snap!
skills.generic.IceTargetedBurstUpgradePr.description:
Place this in your skill tray to improve your Cold Snaps. Every time you
			cast a Cold Snap you have a 75% chance that it will spew out double the
			number of ice crystals for an additional [Description.ManaCost] Mana.! Each additional Ice crystal will cause
			between [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage]
			Ice Damage on initial impact. These bone chilling impacts may additionally
			cause between [skills.generic.IceTargetedBurst.IceModifierEffect.Damage.MinDamage*ModEffect.Duration] 
			to [skills.generic.IceTargetedBurst.IceModifierEffect.Damage.MaxDamage*ModEffect.Duration] Ice Damage over
			[ModEffect.Duration] seconds. On top of that, these secondary crystals
			have a chance to slow a damaged enemy's Movement Speed by 40% and
			Attack Speed by 20% for [SlowModEffect.Duration] seconds. Each crystal can hit up to two enemies!

skills.generic.MageClassPassive.label: Bookworm
skills.generic.MageClassPassive.description:
You have spent most of your life in libraries reading on subjects ranging from thermodynamic entropy to increasing profitability for broccoli farmers below the Tropic of Unicorn - all this knowledge gives you additional Mana points per point of Intellect as well as more Intellect overall. The downside? The lack of exercise has reduced your Health per point of Endurance. Even so, you have managed to read the right diet books and thus have managed to give yourself a slight overall Endurance boost. You spend all day every day reading books and stuff... your atrophying muscles and tendons have reduced your overall Strength and Agility.

skills.generic.MagicDamageModPassive.label: Mental Prowess
skills.generic.MagicDamageModPassive.description:
Mommy dropped you on your head a lot less than the other kids. This has left you with a killer noggin! In other words, you have increased Magic Damage from all skills that you use. However, all that extra brainpower has hurt your physical coordination, slowing both your Ranged and Melee Attack Speeds.

skills.generic.MeleeAttackSpeedModPassiv.label: Way of the Roo
skills.generic.MeleeAttackSpeedModPassiv.description:
You were raised by a semi-domesticated pack of kangaroos that taught you the secret art of Kung Roo. Their teachings have provided you with an increase to both attack speed and attack rating with all Melee weapons. The downside is you pretty much suck with Ranged weapons and your ability to do Magic Damage with skills is also hampered.

skills.generic.PlagueShot.label: Airborne Plague
skills.generic.PlagueShot.description: A shot that releases one of the most deadly and infectious viruses into the air, randomly infecting nearby enemies. Each shot can infect up to 12 enemies dealing [SpellDamageEffect.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageEffect.MaxDamage] <font color=#288B32>Poison Damage</font> upon initial infection and additionally dealing [DOTDamageEffect.MinDamage*ModEffect.Duration] to [DOTDamageEffect.MaxDamage*ModEffect.Duration] <font color=#288B32>Poison Damage</font> over [ModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.PoisonTrail.label: Montezuma's Revenge
skills.generic.PoisonTrail.description:
You ate some seriously bad tofu! Time to get to a toilet, stat! As you run around,
				you will leave some of the most horrendous gas clouds known to Man (and Gosh) behind you! Each gas cloud
				causes somewhere between [DamageEffect.MinDamage] to [DamageEffect.MaxDamage] Poison Damage when an
				enemy runs into it. On top of that, the enemy may take an additional [DamageEffect3.MinDamage*ModEffect3.Duration]
				to [DamageEffect.MaxDamage*ModEffect.Duration] Poison Damage over [ModEffect3.Duration] seconds. 
				Sadly, the bad tofu does leave its mark on you too. You take [DamageEffect3.MinDamage*ModEffect.Duration]
				to [DamageEffect3.MaxDamage*ModEffect.Duration] Fire Damage over [ModEffect2.Duration] seconds as well. Oh, it burns! It burns!

skills.generic.RangeAttackSpeedModPassiv.label: Trigger Happy
skills.generic.RangeAttackSpeedModPassiv.description:
You have a nervous twitch with your trigger finger resulting from a work-related accident involving a branding iron, a penguin, and a large bucket of coffee beans. Your memory of the accident is hazy, but the twitch comes in handy with ranged weapons, giving you increased speed with all ranged weapons. The negative side effects from the accident have left you with a decrease to both your Melee Attack Speed and your overall Magic Damage from skills.

skills.generic.RangerClassPassive.label: Average BMI
skills.generic.RangerClassPassive.description:
Congratulations, you are average! You aren't great, but you don't suck either. You are a bit on the healthier side, gaining additional Health per point of Endurance as well as a few extra points in Endurance. However, all that 'extra' effort has limited your other talents. This decreases your Mana per point of Intellect and your overall Intellect. You haven't let this slow you down though. You make up in your slow wits with your quick feet. You have better Agility at the cost of less Strength.

skills.generic.RangerCoreAttributeTrait.label: Mediocrity
skills.generic.RangerCoreAttributeTrait.description:
Congratulations, you are average! You aren't great, but you don't 
			suck either. No sense in rocking the 
			boat and changing the status quo. You gain 12 Mana per Intellect point
			and 25 Health per Endurance point. Keep up the average work, and don't
			push yourself any harder than you have to.

skills.generic.RangerRangedSpeedTrait.label: Trigger Happy
skills.generic.RangerRangedSpeedTrait.description: You have a nervous twitch with your trigger finger resulting from a 'work-related' accident involving a branding iron, a penguin, and a large bucket of coffee beans. Your memory of the accident is hazy, but the twitch comes in handy with ranged weapons, giving you the innate ability of 25% increased speed with all ranged weapons.

skills.generic.ShadowBlossom.label: Shadow Blossom
skills.generic.ShadowBlossom.description: 10 bolts of shadow energy erupt in a ring from your body and hunt down your enemies dealing [SpellDamageOne.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageOne.MaxDamage] shadow damage per bolt. Each target that gets hit, will then have 6 more bolts of shadow energy erupt in a ring from their body and fly outward penetrating through enemies dealing [SpellDamageTwo.MinDamage] to [SpellDamageTwo.MaxDamage] shadow damage per hit.

skills.generic.ShadowTendrils.label: Shadow Word(s): Bad Touch
skills.generic.ShadowTendrils.description:
You dig long and deep within your inner psyche to release a bunch of your pent 
					up teenage angst. Doing so causes up to [BogusMod.Value] dark tendrils
					of Shadow energy to emerge from your soul and randomly grow. Any enemy
					that is inappropriately touched by a tendril will take
					[DamageEffect.MinDamage] to [DamageEffect.MaxDamage] Shadow Damage. In
					addition to that, the damaged enemy has a chance to be stricken with a
					curse that increases all Shadow Damage they receive by
					[DamageTakenMod.Value]% for [CurseModEffect.Duration] seconds! This curse
					can be stacked twice on one enemy.

skills.generic.SnowmanHealthModAuraPassi.label: Snow Globe
skills.generic.SnowmanHealthModAuraPassi.description: With all the Dungeon Warming going on these days, it's best to give your snowman a fighting chance. Your snow globe will provide any friendly snowmen within 10 meters of you with a max health increase of [AttributeEffect.Value]% as long as they remain within that range. This does not stack.

skills.generic.SnowManIceDamageProcAuraM.label: Nippy Twigs
skills.generic.SnowManIceDamageProcAuraM.description:
As long as Chill Bill is within 7.5 meters of you, he will dish out ice damage every time his feeble little twig hands strike his target. The amount of additional ice damage is 350% more than his normal physical damage! But wait, there's more!
			Each successful frigid hit also slows the target's Move Speed and Attack Speed by [-AttackSpeedMod.Value]% for [SpellModEffect.Duration] seconds.

skills.generic.SummonerClassPassive.label: Couch Potato
skills.generic.SummonerClassPassive.description:
When you turn on the magi-vision with the 'mystical' remote, it winds you. The magi-vision has infused your brain with countless tidbits of 'useful' information, giving you additional Intellect and Mana per point of Intellect. Unfortunately, sitting around on the couch doing a whole lot of nothing has decreased your Health per Endurance as well as your overall Endurance. Curling the remote control has given you a boost in Strength, but your Agility has suffered a bit from all the sitting.
